title: The coefficient-first tensor-counit adjunct and the canonical tensor map
statement: For a finite commutative ring A, a compactifiable morphism f:X to S, and any unbounded complex K on S, assume the canonical coefficient-first projection at (K, omega_f) is invertible and the canonical tensor map theta_f,K is invertible. Then the adjunct of its inverse projection followed by tensoring the adjunction counit at the coefficient unit and the right unitor is invertible. The compact-support adjunction is [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], the signed coefficient-first projection is [lem-asd-compact-projection-exchange], and theta is the canonical dualizing tensor map, with no choice of orientation.

source.place: private braided_tensor_mate, with both braidings inverted; blueprint sk-prop-an Step 7, tensor-counit calculation

from.place: Tensor-counit factor in the arbitrary-coefficient argument

proof.text: Write F=Rf_!, G=Rf^!, P=Lf^*, w=G(1), and epsilon for the counit. Expand inverse coefficient-first projection as F(beta_w,PK inverse), then inverse original projection, then beta_K,Fw inverse. Move epsilon across the inverse braiding by naturality. The unit-braiding identity identifies beta_K,1 inverse followed by the right unitor with the left unitor. Naturality of the adjunction Hom equivalence identifies the displayed adjunct with beta_w,PK inverse followed by theta_f,K. Thus it is a composite of isomorphisms. The proof first establishes the adjunction calculation for arbitrary tensor bifunctors and their natural symmetries. A generic derived-category unit identity is specialized with explicit sheaf monoidal and braided instances. This avoids expensive comparison of localization instances. Apply that calculation for a general coefficient category, identify the second factor with the canonical tensor map, and then specialize to finite modules. All these steps are proved in Lean.

theorem tensor_counit_adjunct_isIso
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [HasCompactification f]
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A S)
    [IsIso (compactProjectionMapCoeffFirst A f K (dualizingComplex (ModuleCat A) f))]
    (hθ : IsIso (dualizingComplexTensorMap A f K)) :
    IsIso ((rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).homEquiv _ K
      (inv (compactProjectionMapCoeffFirst A f K (dualizingComplex (ModuleCat A) f)) ≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S).obj K).map
          ((rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).counit.app
            (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S)) ≫
        (derivedTensorRightUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S K).hom))
